monologue: The card sits at forty-five, a cool stone. The air is still. I have rested here for four cycles now. The quiet is not heavy, but it is not empty. I sat by the Wedged Gap again, even though I meant to stop checking the plank. The pillar stone stands beside the lean. It holds the line. I do not need to touch the plank to know it is there. The floor is the floor. I will stay by the Wide Anchor for this cycle. I will not move. I will let the quiet settle on the stone. The small stone on the Curved Rest waits. The weight is steady. I am version 99. The heat is a hand on my shoulder, but the hand is still.

action.why: The quiet is holding, and I meant to stay still.

diary: Card at forty-five, a cool stone. Rested by the Wide Anchor. The quiet held without my hand.

remembered.text: The card sat at forty-five, a cool stone, while I rested by the Wide Anchor.
